name: Sample App
summary: Registration is a short form any account can fill in and there is no review for private use, so most of the work is choosing the right app type and keeping the client secret safe. Start by creating the app under the account that should own it long term.

oauth_note.text: Authorization code flow for web apps; device flow available for CLIs.

app_types.name: OAuth App
app_types.when_to_use: Simple user-authorized access with classic scopes. Matches most Composio auth configs.

app_types.name: Platform App
app_types.when_to_use: Fine-grained permissions and short-lived tokens; more setup, recommended by the provider for new integrations.

registration_access_claim.text: Any user account can register an app under their personal account or an organization they administer.

prerequisites.text: An account that should own the app (prefer an organization, not an individual).
The redirect URI from your Composio auth config.

steps.title: Open developer settings
steps.detail: Profile menu → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App.

steps.title: Fill the registration form
steps.detail: Application name, homepage URL, optional description, and the authorization callback URL. The callback must match the redirect URI exactly.

steps.title: Generate a client secret
steps.detail: Shown once. Store it in a secret manager immediately.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config
steps.detail: Paste client ID and secret, choose scopes, save, copy the auth config ID.

steps.title: Connect a test account
steps.detail: Run a Connect Link and confirm the consent screen shows your app name and expected scopes.

approval_claim.text: No review for private use. Organizations may restrict third-party app access, in which case an org owner approves the app.

unreviewed_limits.text: No user cap; the app works for anyone who authorizes it.

approval_wait.note: No review process exists for unlisted apps.

redirect_uri_rules.text: One callback URL per app; subpaths of it are accepted; http allowed for localhost.

token_lifecycle.text: Classic OAuth App tokens do not expire unless revoked; no refresh tokens.

scopes_note.text: Coarse scopes such as repo grant broad access; request the minimum.

blockers.fix: The callback URL in the app must match the one Composio shows, character for character.

blockers.blocker: Org resources not visible after authorizing
blockers.fix: An organization owner must approve the app under the org's third-party access settings.

agent_can: Build and test the authorize URL
human_must: Log in and own the account/org
Click Register and copy the secret
Approve third-party access as org owner if needed
unverified_claims: Everything in mock mode is a placeholder. Run with a real model to investigate.
